/// Extension methods for registering Pragmatic endpoints.

public static class PragmaticEndpointsRegistrationExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Maps all Pragmatic endpoints to the route builder.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="endpoints">The endpoint route builder.</param>
    /// <returns>The endpoint route builder for chaining.</returns>
    public static Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder MapPragmaticEndpoints(this Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)
    {
        var pragmaticOptions = endpoints.ServiceProvider.GetService<global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.PragmaticEndpointsOptions>() ?? new global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.PragmaticEndpointsOptions();
        var prefix = pragmaticOptions.RoutePrefix;
        // Always use MapGroup to get RouteGroupBuilder (IEndpointConventionBuilder) for auth/rate-limit
        var root = endpoints.MapGroup(prefix);
        
        if (pragmaticOptions.RequireAuthorizationByDefault)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pragmaticOptions.DefaultAuthorizationPolicy))
                root.RequireAuthorization(pragmaticOptions.DefaultAuthorizationPolicy);
            else
                root.RequireAuthorization();
        }
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pragmaticOptions.DefaultRateLimitPolicy))
            root.RequireRateLimiting(pragmaticOptions.DefaultRateLimitPolicy);
        if (!pragmaticOptions.EnableOpenApi)
            global::Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.OpenApiRouteHandlerBuilderExtensions.ExcludeFromDescription(root);
        
        // Ungrouped endpoints
        global::TestApp.Orders.DeleteOrderEndpoint.MapEndpoint(root);
        
        return endpoints;
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers all Pragmatic endpoint services for dependency injection.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
    /// <returns>The service collection for chaining.</returns>
    public static Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection AddPragmaticEndpoints(this Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // Read PragmaticEndpointsOptions that was registered by a prior AddPragmaticEndpoints() call.
        // We avoid BuildServiceProvider() (which creates a second root container) by reading the descriptor directly.
        var __optsDescriptor = services.LastOrDefault(d => d.ServiceType == typeof(global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.PragmaticEndpointsOptions) && d.Lifetime == global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceLifetime.Singleton);
        var __opts = __optsDescriptor?.ImplementationInstance as global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.PragmaticEndpointsOptions;
        
        global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.ApiExplorer.PragmaticApiDescriptionExtensions.AddPragmaticApiDescriptions(services);
        
        // Rate limiting — inline [RateLimit(Requests, Window)] + named ConfigureRateLimiter() policies.
        // Always registered so runtime DefaultRateLimitPolicy/group/named policies resolve.
        var endpointOptions = __opts;
        var rejectionCode = endpointOptions?.RateLimitRejectionStatusCode ?? 429;
        services.AddRateLimiter(rateLimiterOptions =>
        {
            rateLimiterOptions.RejectionStatusCode = rejectionCode;
            
            // Named policies — from PragmaticEndpointsOptions.ConfigureRateLimiter().
            // Per caller unless the configuration asks for one shared bucket (Global).
            if (endpointOptions?.RateLimiters is { Count: > 0 } rateLimiters)
            {
                foreach (var (name, config) in rateLimiters)
                {
                    switch (config.Strategy)
                    {
                        case global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.RateLimiterStrategy.FixedWindow:
                            rateLimiterOptions.AddPolicy(name, httpContext => config.Global
                                ? global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(name, _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions { PermitLimit = config.PermitLimit, Window = config.Window, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit })
                                : global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartitionKey.For(httpContext, name), _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions { PermitLimit = config.PermitLimit, Window = config.Window, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit }));
                            break;
                        case global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.RateLimiterStrategy.SlidingWindow:
                            rateLimiterOptions.AddPolicy(name, httpContext => config.Global
                                ? global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetSlidingWindowLimiter(name, _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.SlidingWindowRateLimiterOptions { PermitLimit = config.PermitLimit, Window = config.Window, SegmentsPerWindow = config.SegmentsPerWindow, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit })
                                : global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetSlidingWindowLimiter(global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartitionKey.For(httpContext, name), _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.SlidingWindowRateLimiterOptions { PermitLimit = config.PermitLimit, Window = config.Window, SegmentsPerWindow = config.SegmentsPerWindow, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit }));
                            break;
                        case global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.RateLimiterStrategy.TokenBucket:
                            rateLimiterOptions.AddPolicy(name, httpContext => config.Global
                                ? global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetTokenBucketLimiter(name, _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.TokenBucketRateLimiterOptions { TokenLimit = config.PermitLimit, ReplenishmentPeriod = config.Window, TokensPerPeriod = config.TokensPerPeriod > 0 ? config.TokensPerPeriod : config.PermitLimit, AutoReplenishment = config.AutoReplenishment, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit })
                                : global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetTokenBucketLimiter(global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartitionKey.For(httpContext, name), _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.TokenBucketRateLimiterOptions { TokenLimit = config.PermitLimit, ReplenishmentPeriod = config.Window, TokensPerPeriod = config.TokensPerPeriod > 0 ? config.TokensPerPeriod : config.PermitLimit, AutoReplenishment = config.AutoReplenishment, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit }));
                            break;
                        case global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.Configuration.RateLimiterStrategy.Concurrency:
                            rateLimiterOptions.AddPolicy(name, httpContext => config.Global
                                ? global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetConcurrencyLimiter(name, _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.ConcurrencyLimiterOptions { PermitLimit = config.PermitLimit, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit })
                                : global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition.GetConcurrencyLimiter(global::Pragmatic.Endpoints.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartitionKey.For(httpContext, name), _ => new global::System.Threading.RateLimiting.ConcurrencyLimiterOptions { PermitLimit = config.PermitLimit, QueueLimit = config.QueueLimit }));
                            break;
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        
        // DomainAction invokers are registered by the generated Add{Prefix}Actions() extension
        // (or by the Composition host). AddPragmaticActions() only wires the pipeline (filters,
        // call context, authorization registries) — it does NOT register invokers.
        // Raw endpoints are instantiated with new() and need no DI registration.
        // Standalone (no host): call BOTH AddPragmaticActions() and the generated AddActions()
        // before MapPragmaticEndpoints() so IDomainActionInvoker<T,R> resolves.
        
        return services;
    }

namespace TestAssembly;

/// <summary>
///     Compile-time route constants and typed URL builders for every endpoint in this
///     assembly, grouped by boundary. Used by the typed test client and link generation.
/// </summary>
public static class ApiRoutes
{
    /// <summary>Routes for the Orders boundary.</summary>
    public static class Orders
    {
        /// <summary>DELETE /orders/{id}</summary>
        public const string DeleteOrderMethod = "DELETE";
        
        /// <summary>Route template for DeleteOrder.</summary>
        public const string DeleteOrderTemplate = "/orders/{id}";
        
        /// <summary>Builds the DeleteOrder URL from typed parameters.</summary>
        public static string DeleteOrder(int id)
        {
            var __url = $"/orders/{__Fmt(id)}";
            return __url;
        }
    }
    
    /// <summary>Invariant-culture, URL-escaped value formatting for route/query values.</summary>
    private static string __Fmt<T>(T value)
        => System.Uri.EscapeDataString(string.Format(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", value));
}
